name: Matt Freeman
background: Matt Freeman ran as the Constitution Party nominee for House District 41 in 2022 and lost the Nov. 8, 2022 general election. His Secretary of State general-election filing listed a Cheyenne mailing address. No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the filings and coverage reviewed for this Profile.
